description: This file defines the TranslationStatusForm class in Drupal, responsible for rendering and handling a form that displays translation status and manages translation updates within the Drupal locale module.

classes.name: TranslationStatusForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class that displays translation status and handles translation updates.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with module handler, state, and time services.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the translation status form with language list, status, and update options.

methods.name: prepareUpdateData
methods.description: Prepares data about projects with available translation updates.

methods.name: createInfoString
methods.description: Generates debug info for missing translation files based on source configuration.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates that at least one language is selected for update.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to initiate translation updates or fetches.
